stem: Why is the leaf Saeng carries important in the excerpt?

options.label: A
options.text: It helps Saeng find a plant that causes her to have vivid memories of her childhood.

options.label: B
options.text: It was given to Saeng by someone important to Saeng during her childhood.

options.label: C
options.text: It leads Saeng to discover a new and beautiful plant.

options.label: D
options.text: It is essential in teaching Saeng about her past.
